events.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
events.summary: Health in ChatGPT now lets eligible U.S. users securely connect medical records and Apple Health to get more personalized insights and better understand their health.
events.summary_zh: Health in ChatGPT 现允许符合条件的美国用户安全连接医疗记录和 Apple Health，以获得更个性化的洞察，更好地了解自身健康状况。
events.subject: OpenAI

events.title: This Time Is Different: Why AI Is Unlike Any Wave I Have Seen In 40 Years Of Financial Services
events.summary: AI will fundamentally rewrite the global financial value chain, making marginal operating costs near-zero and creating highly personalized, previously impossible products, argues guest columnist Nigel Morris of QED Investors. He warns that success will depend on whether incumbent banks and fintechs are willing to self-cannibalize and rebuild their operations around this transformative technology.
events.summary_zh: QED Investors 客座专栏作者 Nigel Morris 认为，AI 将从根本上重塑全球金融价值链，使边际运营成本接近于零，并创造高度个性化、过去无法实现的产品。他警告称，成功取决于现有银行和金融科技公司是否愿意自我蚕食，并围绕这项变革性技术重建运营体系。

events.title: Build in public, fail in public: what it’s like to be a founder under 20 right now
events.summary: AI tools have democratized the opportunity to build, shortening the timelines of success and enabling more young people to start successful companies without stepping foot inside a Big Tech company.
events.summary_zh: AI 工具让创业机会更加普及，缩短成功所需的时间，也让更多年轻人无需进入大型科技公司就能创办成功企业。
events.subject: TechCrunch

events.title: AegisAI, founded by former Google security execs, lands $36M to stop AI-driven spear phishing
events.summary: AegisAI co-founders developed AI agents that quickly analyze each message as a human would, paying attention to small anomalies that even the most elaborate checklist wouldn’t catch.
events.summary_zh: 由前 Google 安全高管创立的 AegisAI 获得 $36M 融资，用于阻止 AI 驱动的鱼叉式网络钓鱼。其联合创始人开发了 AI 智能体，能够像人类一样快速分析每条消息，关注即使最复杂的检查清单也可能遗漏的细微异常。
events.subject: TechCrunch

events.title: Led By DeepSeek, 10 Frontier Labs Rush Onto The Crunchbase Unicorn Board In June
events.summary: A total of 34 companies joined The Crunchbase Unicorn Board in June, altogether adding more than $110 billion in value, with 10 of those companies AI labs, which were collectively valued at $65 billion. Other leading sectors with multiple companies were in robotics and AI infrastructure.
events.summary_zh: 6 月共有 34 家公司加入 The Crunchbase Unicorn Board，合计新增价值超过 $110B，其中 10 家为 AI 实验室，合计估值 $65B。机器人和 AI 基础设施也是拥有多家公司的主要领域。
